entry_points.text: A constructor binds system instruction encodings to trap handlers.
Address-translate traps decode operation from syndrome and forward guest address to lower helpers; one EL2 variant injects undefined when its feature is absent.

AArch64 trap triages, decodes, selects register or instruction table, performs access and writes back only system reads; 32-bit path delegates with CP15 reroutes, miss delegating to unhandled yet reporting handled.
CP14 loads and stores always inject undefined; 64-bit path decodes direction and selectors, builds one operand from two registers and splits back on read; CP10 traps emulate feature registers.
VGIC probe maps KVM encodings to descriptors, failing unknown or hidden; platform info installs once; irqfd injects shared levels; ITS debug file is read-only with no teardown.

exports.text: 64-bit CP15 and CP14 plus 32-bit CP14 handlers delegate to shared helpers with their tables.

hazards.text: Second-stage unmap may drop the lock and sleep so concurrent recycle is expected; safety rests on invalidate-before-reuse, tolerable stale entries, safe over-unmapping and stable nested tables.
Maintenance may arrive asynchronously with folding deferred; nested path samples missed level, injects configured ID then clears enable.

invariants.text: Table centralizes trap, reset, backing, userspace and visibility; most interrupt controls default to undefined; PMU, cache and timers use dedicated routines; nested EL2 splits plain, VNCR, redirected, filtered and undefined with gated visibility; resets mostly zero or unknown, aux all ones, cache masked, FP 1792.
Combined stage one-two and IPA invalidations require matching features for shareability, outer-shareable and range forms; unsupported encodings trap as undefined.

Miss without table returns not-handled; two classes map to coprocessors 14 and 15 with log and warn otherwise; CP10 accepts only reads of three IDs 7,6,5; CP15 writes unsupported and high values read zero; debug ID synthesizes reads.

Syndrome decoding extracts operation and control fields with low bit as direction; encoding builder splits architectural values; reset asserts valid index and stores value; lookup orders by encoding subtraction; constructors initialize mapping and selectors; uses bit-field helpers.

Early mapping keeps low bits and inserts tag; layout picks opposite top bit, derives boundary from DRAM with optional randomization; relocations resolve via alias; translation needs five slots and vector four with Spectre gating, faulting otherwise; 64-bit constants use four moves.

Control restore validates widths and capability bits, rejecting mismatches, then forwards only points and mode; VMCR dispatch selects version with v2 fallback, faulting on unknown; each version packs enables, points and mask into its word.

Control combines widths and trap bits with stored points and mode; mask, points and enables are views of one record; APR slots derive from encoding with width-capped max; EL1 enable must stay set; EL2 values immutable; generic EL2 stores directly; static table binds controls hidden unless nested.
Distributor summary reports model, counts and enable with per-IRQ type by range and refreshed pending for host SGIs; ITS output shows device headers then linked translations.

locks.text: Full invalidation takes VM memory lock in write mode, drops shadow tables with broadcast, then releases; per-identifier iteration manages its own sleepable sync.
Debug printing holds per-IRQ raw spinlock with IRQs saved; ITS walk holds ITS mutex from start to stop with seeding and offset skip; LPI counting uses RCU sections.

state_machines.text: Scoped invalidations validate, read identifier from nested base, then iterate full to limit, range with capped base, or single masked IPA; EL2 uses EL2 path while EL1 in EL2 splits on host controls and assumes EL2 context with successful primitive.

Access traces, rejects hidden with undefined, treats missing handler as host bug, otherwise runs handler and advances PC only on success; system-register miss logs, injects undefined and reports not-handled.

Identifier and reserved-bits debug walks scan the global table in order, filter by feature or sanitised index, select by position, yield nothing until ready, step without teardown and print name with hex value or masks.

Alternate point follows common flag with capped alias; debug walk visits distributor, then private IDs across vCPUs, then shared and LPIs under RCU in order, failing alloc with no-memory; ITS advance stays in device table then moves to next device first entry.

structs.text: TLBI parameters carry range, IPA or virtual-address payloads; decoded parameters hold five selectors, value and direction; descriptors hold name, mapping, selectors, callbacks, storage index, value, userspace and visibility hooks.
Instruction table routes cache, translate and invalidation forms to dedicated handlers; CP14 and CP15 tables map debug, cache, PMU, timer and GIC encodings with per-index and counter-split helpers.
Distributor iterator tracks counts and position; ITS position is device plus entry with null pair as end.
Visibility bits mark hidden, read-zero and user-ignore; TRNG version 65536 with success, unsupported, invalid, no-entropy and 192-bit cap; maintenance IRQ 25.
